headline: Commentary: Survey finds fear, desire for reset in Washington. Will Trump accept the results?
summary: A Virginia Mercury poll of over 350 readers found Virginians' top concerns heading into midterms were rising food prices, healthcare access, and energy costs, with many also expressing fears about threats to democracy by President Trump. Early voting numbers have surpassed 2022 totals, suggesting high voter engagement.

headline: Virginia governor pledges overhaul of outdated K-12 school funding formula
summary: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger has committed to overhauling the state's outdated K-12 funding formula within her current administration (ending in 2029). This process, expected to take up to 24 months, aims to better reflect real costs and address monetary gaps to meet student needs. The new formula will be student-driven, addressing regional differences and enabling districts to attract staff and procure specialized resources. Lawmakers will discuss education legislation, including hiring a consultant to shape the new formula, starting Jan. 13.

headline: Hundreds march from Biloxi to Ocean Springs, calling for justice for Nolan Wells
summary: Hundreds marched from Biloxi to Ocean Springs demanding justice for Nolan Wells, an 18-year-old found dead under suspicious circumstances on Horn Island. Protesters alleged racial bias, referencing other cases of Black lives lost, and called for independent investigations.
